title: Created a trailer for game Rampage where you're a car mowing through hordes of monsters.
author: MapApprehensive1867
selftext:
Hi! I've been building Rampage: Hell on Wheels, a 3D driving survival game that runs in your browser. Like vampire survivors, but you drive a hearse with Gatling guns and ram everything in sight.



Play free: \[https://run.world/silverbolt106/rampage-hell-on-wheels\] (runs in the browser, nothing to install) No Pay2Win  


What's in it:

\- Up to 800 monsters on screen at once, plus bosses like the Pumpkin King

\- Six stages: Midnight Graveyard, Frostbite Necropolis, Sakura Spirit Shrine, Carnival of the Damned, Sunken Reef Ruins and more

\- Rides like Hellcat, Bonecrusher, Frankenwagon, Pumpkin Coach and the Mastiff X4, each with its own mastery

\- Weapons that level up and evolve: Gatling, Mortar, Tesla, Saws, Flame, Toxic and more, with Limit Break bonuses once you max them out

\- Slow-motion rams, nitro, shrines, coffins, relics and per-level leaderboards



Everything in the trailer is real gameplay captured from the live game. No pre-rendered shots.  


It's still in active development. I'm planning stage completion goals, unlock challenges and more weapon types next, so I'd love feedback on how it feels to play. What would you want added?
